text:
Elena (net-arch): follow-up from the control-plane v2 RFC. we need a pragmatic cutover for private endpoints that avoids traffic duplication and keeps src-ip stable for NAT customers.
Tom (infra): agree. ops constraint: some customers have strict source-based ACLs. can we promise a short sticky window?
Elena (net-arch): plan: short dual-advertise window + session-affinity tokens issued by controlplane. affinity TTL 120s by default, configurable per-tenant. expose `migration_mode=canary|force|off`.
Ravi (onboarding): can we default new tenants to canary and provide a one-click opt-out in our admin UI? also a CLI: `rctl tenant set-migration TID --mode off`.
Elena (net-arch): yep. server fallback: if v2 handshake fails 4 times, pin that tenant back to v1 for 15m and emit metric `cp_v2_fallbacks_total`.
Nina (eng-sre): add metrics: `cp_v2_attempts_total`, `cp_v2_fallbacks_total`, `cp_v2_handshake_latency_ms` histogram. alert when >0.5% tenants in fallback for 10m.
Omar (product): customers will ask about downtime and billing. one-liner for docs: "No planned downtime; long-lived sessions may see transient IP continuity changes. contact SE for strict ACL requirements."
Tom (infra): token details: signed route tokens valid 6m, rotate via controlplane. need a token renewer binary for on-prem and air-gapped installs or require relay-agent.
Ravi (onboarding): we'll ship a tiny token-renewer (single static binary ~1.5MB) with `/healthz` and a file/socket output. that helps installers.
Elena (net-arch): migration steps (high-level):
1) set migration_mode=canary (dry-run)
2) deploy token-renewer or ensure relay-agent present
3) dual-push DNS with apex TTL=45s for 5-10 minutes
4) monitor `cp_v2_fallbacks_total` and handshake latency, then promote to force
Nina (eng-sre): implementation note: implement affinity via token verification rather than routing table pinning to reduce thrash. token includes tenant_id, route_hash, issued_at, HMAC.
Tom (infra): DNS approach: short apex TTL + longer helper TTLs. recommend dual duration 8 minutes.
ci-bot: build started: token-renewer v0.1 -> staging (sha: f1a2b3)
Ravi (onboarding): prep CLI commands and an opt-out flow for customers with strict ACLs.
Elena (net-arch): action items: spec token format + sequence diagram (Elena), token-renewer binary (Ravi/Tom), metrics + alert rules (Nina), customer docs + email template (Omar). will link addendum to RFC when ready.
